**STEP 1 - Scene:** A snack of whole almonds (raw or lightly roasted) in a small white foam bowl. Nothing else is on the plate.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** A small white bowl, roughly cereal-bowl size, about 14 cm in diameter. Area = 3.14 × (7)² ≈ 154 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:** Whole almonds only. No oil, dressing, or sauce is visible.

**STEP 4 - Area:** The almonds fill most of the bowl's opening, about 80% of the vessel area (≈123 cm²).

**STEP 5 - Volume:** Almonds are piled about 2 cm deep. 123 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 246 ml gross.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** Whole nuts pack loosely, so I use a bulk density of about 0.45–0.5 g/ml. 246 ml × 0.45 ≈ 110 g, rounded to about 100 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Almonds are about 579 kcal per 100 g. 100 g × 5.79 ≈ 580 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** A bowl of about 70 almonds at roughly 1.2 g each comes to about 80–100 g, which matches the estimate. Total ≈ 100 g, ≈ 580 kcal.
